summary.headline: Lunar Omens by Zodiac Sign
summary.text: Lunar electional and omen rules for the Moon in Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, and Libra, covering travel, marriage, illness, childbirth, miscarriage, fugitives, stolen goods, bondage, sowing, and planting. Marginal and editorial notes preserve Greek readings and a warning about beginning activities around the full Moon in Libra and Scorpio.
